AgentSys 

 
 A modular runtime and orchestration system for AI agents. 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 11 plugins · 5 agents · 14 skills (across all repos) · 13k lines of lib code · tests on Linux and Windows · 5 platforms 
 Plugins distributed as standalone repos under agent-sh org - agentsys is the marketplace & installer 
 

 Running open models for your company? Tiyuvta helps with model choice, deployment and optimization, and fine-tuning on your hardware or cloud account.

 
 
 
 Built and maintained with a lot of agent tokens and hours. If it saves you time, sponsoring helps keep it going. 

 
 Commands · Installation · Website · Discussions 
 

 
 Built for Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · Cursor · Kiro 
 

 New skills, agents, and integrations ship constantly. Follow for real-time updates: 
 
 
 

---

AI models can write code. That's not the hard part anymore. The hard part is everything around it - branch management, code review, artifact cleanup, CI, PR comments. AgentSys is the runtime that orchestrates agents to handle all of it - structured pipelines, gated phases, specialized agents, and persistent state that survives session boundaries.

---
 Building custom skills, agents, hooks, or MCP tools? agnix is the CLI + LSP linter that catches config errors before they fail silently - real-time IDE validation, auto suggestions, auto-fix, and 757 rules for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cline, Windsurf, Roo Code, Amp, and more.

 What's New in 6.1.1

- OpenCode, Codex, Cursor and Kiro installs get the plugins that ship no .claude-plugin/plugin.json at their pin. The installer fetched such a plugin and installed nothing from it. It now makes one from the marketplace entry, as Claude Code does.
- agnix installs its /agnix command, agent and skill on every platform. Claude Code installed only its skill before, and the other platforms nothing. The marketplace entry is now a git-subdir source for the plugin's plugin/ folder.
- The installer fetches a git-subdir source as that folder, pinned by sha or commit .
- Contributor docs: every change reaches main through a PR, and a release commit merges through a PR with only the tag pushed.

 What This Is

An agent orchestration system - 11 plugins, 5 agents, and 14 skills that compose into structured pipelines for software development. Each plugin lives in its own standalone repo under the agent-sh org. agentsys is the marketplace and installer that ties them together.

Each agent has a single responsibility, a specific model assignment, and defined inputs/outputs. Pipelines enforce phase gates so agents can't skip steps. State persists across sessions so work survives interruptions.

The system runs on Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Cursor, and Kiro. Install via the marketplace or the npm installer, and the plugins are fetched automatically from their repos.

---

 The Approach

 Code does code work. AI does AI work. 

- Detection : regex, AST analysis, static analysis - fast, deterministic, no tokens wasted
- Judgment : LLM calls for synthesis, planning, review - where reasoning matters
- Result : certainty-graded findings throughout

 Certainty levels exist because not all findings are equal: 

 Level Meaning Action 
 ------- --------- -------- 
 HIGH Definitely a problem Safe to auto-fix 
 MEDIUM Probably a problem Needs context 
 LOW Might be a problem Needs human judgment 

This came from testing on 1,000+ repositories.

---

 Commands

 Command What it does 
 --------- -------------- 
 /foreman Work the GitHub issue queue with native subagents, from pick to land 
 /banthis Durable negative memory: persist banned agent behaviors 
 /agnix Lint agent configurations (757 rules) 
 /deslop Clean AI slop patterns 
 /learn Research topics, create learning guides 
 /skillers Workflow pattern learning and automation 
 /skill-curator Create and improve reliable SKILL.md files 
 /system-prompt-curator Create and improve autonomous agent system prompts 

Each command works standalone. Together, they compose into end-to-end pipelines.

---

 Skills

14 skills included across the plugins:

 Category Skills 
 ---------- -------- 
 Workflow foreman 
 Message Queues glide-mq-migrate-bee , glide-mq-migrate-bullmq , glide-mq 
 Enhancement skill-curator , system-prompt-curator 
 Cleanup deslop 
 AI Collaboration learn , recommend , skillers-compact 
 Memory banthis 
 Linting agnix 
 Languages ada-spark , mojo 

 External skill plugins (standalone repos, installed separately):

 Category Skills Plugin 
 ---------- -------- -------- 
 Message Queues glide-mq , glide-mq-migrate-bullmq , glide-mq-migrate-bee agent-sh/glidemq 

Skills are the reusable implementation units. Agents invoke skills; commands orchestrate agents. When you install a plugin, its skills become available to all agents in that session.

 Skill-Only Plugins

Plugins without a / command. The marketplace ones install with agentsys; glide-mq installs from its own repo.

 Plugin What it does 
 -------- -------------- 
 mojo mojo skill: current Mojo syntax, ownership, SIMD and GPU kernels, Python interop 
 ada-spark ada-spark skill: Ada 2022 and SPARK contracts, proof, Alire and GNAT tooling 
 zig-lsp Zig language server for Claude Code via ZLS (no skill). Needs zls on PATH 

 glide-mq

Build message queues, background jobs, and workflow orchestration with glide-mq - high-performance Node.js queue on Valkey/Redis. Not in the agentsys marketp

install.title: Installation
install.html:
Claude Code (Recommended way)
/plugin marketplace add agent-sh/agentsys
/plugin install foreman@agentsys
All Platforms (npm)
npm install -g agentsys && agentsys

Interactive installer for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Cursor, and Kiro.

# Non-interactive install
agentsys --tool claude              # Single tool
agentsys --tool cursor              # Cursor (~/.cursor: skills, commands, rules)
agentsys --tool kiro                # Kiro (~/.kiro: prompts, skills, agents)
agentsys --tools "claude,opencode"  # Multiple tools
agentsys --development              # Dev mode (bypasses marketplace)
agentsys install deslop             # One plugin, or plugin:component for one agent, skill or command

Full installation guide →
